description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeController class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class extends AbstractVueController and manages employee-related operations, specifically preparing data and permissions for rendering the employee list component in the user interface.

classes.name: EmployeeController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee data and permissions for the user interface, extending the AbstractVueController to leverage Vue.js components in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and configures the employee list component, retrieves employee deletion permissions based on user roles, and sets the component and permissions in the context prior to rendering.
